COD.note: No count of people holding a national ID; the document says the population has had no ID card since 1984.
No system in service; operator role of ONIP is only prospective and no supplier runs a system.
Electoral data moves into the ONIP database, not a register keyed on the ID number.

facts.fact: ACTUALITE.CD, citing the Interior minister to the Council of Ministers on 14 November 2025, says ONIP is preparing to restart identification operations, starting in pilot province Kinshasa, with a biometric national card planned for 2026.
